program.name: Strength Supersets
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Opposing muscles in supersets: push with pull, squat with hinge, so more work fits in 40 minutes.
program.about: Opposing muscles paired in supersets, so one rests while the other works: push with pull, squat with hinge. That fits more strength work into forty minutes without cutting rest. Upper and lower days alternate, with abs to finish. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III slows every lowering to three seconds. Good once straight sets start to feel long.
